integrity: A self-contained mathematical derivation and executable exact-arithmetic checks are supplied; computations are finite corroborations and no independent external mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Planar independent run-and-tumble transport with iid symmetric angle increments, Poisson turns, uniform initial orientation and only the first three angular relaxation rates strictly positive; projected displacement, asymptotic cumulant linear-growth coefficients up to order six. Not finite-time Gaussianity, interacting active matter or higher-cumulant cancellation.
title: Sharp sixth-cumulant obstruction after fourth-cumulant cancellation in planar run-and-tumble transport
